Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000525": As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000511": On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas flagged that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, noting the notifier is not their service.  (about: Team Atlas, notifier)
- memory_id "1000504" [preference]: As of 2025-07-03, for the current Team Atlas on-call cycle, page Priya for anything instead of Tomasz Nowak.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya, Tomasz Nowak)
- memory_id "1000496": As of 2025-07-02, Team Atlas consists of Priya only, after Tomasz Nowak transferred to Team Dune.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya, Tomasz Nowak)
- memory_id "1000492": As of 2025-07-02, Tomasz Nowak has transferred from Team Atlas to Team Dune.  (about: Team Atlas, Tomasz Nowak, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000468": On 2025-05-23, the Ember team flagged that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout.  (about: webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000455": As of 2025-06-19, the notifier lives with Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000447": As of 2025-06-16, Team Boreal owns the catalog service, having taken it over from Team Dune.  (about: Team Boreal, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000433": Team Dune sits on the fourth floor.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000430": On 2025-06-12, Team Dune noticed the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000391" [decision]: As of 2025-05-09, Team Dune has switched to a monthly game day.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000379": As of 2025-05-09, Tomasz Nowak is the Team Atlas on-call contact for this cycle instead of Priya.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya, Tomasz Nowak)
- memory_id "1000327": The catalog service relies on the resizer for thumbnails, so if the resizer is down, the catalog service is down.  (about: catalog service, resizer)
- memory_id "1000263": As of 2025-03-24, Farah still has the Team Dune pager.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000250": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000162" [preference]: For the Atlas on-call cycle starting 2025-02-19, page Tomasz Nowak instead of Priya for anything.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya, Tomasz Nowak)
- memory_id "1000129": Team Dune owns the reporting service.  (about: Team Dune, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000098": Farah takes the first on-call rotation for Team Dune.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000053": As of January 2025, Team Dune consists of Farah alone.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000048": Farah runs Team Dune solo until the next hire lands.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
Existing entity names: Team Atlas, Team Dune, webhooks service, notifier, Priya, Tomasz Nowak, Ember team, Team Boreal, catalog service, resizer, Farah, Team Cinder, reporting service
